name: Chainwhip refunds 20% of its cooldown when it interrupts a cast (#5461)
contract: Chainwhip (base 800081, level-80 rank 503367, confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset) has Effect0=2 (SCHOOL_DAMAGE), Effect1=63 (THREAT), Effect2=6/APPLY_AURA with EffectApplyAuraName[2]=27 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE); InterruptFlags=0 and no effect is 68 (SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST), RecoveryTime=20000ms, CastingTimeIndex=1 (SpellCastTimes row 1 = 0ms, instant). Its description reads 'If you successfully interrupt an enemy, this will refund $800835s1% of the cooldown', and 800835's EffectBasePoints[0]=19 (+1 = 20%). Because Chainwhip's own effects never trigger Spell::EffectInterruptCast (only SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST spells raise sScriptMgr->OnSpellSuccessfulInterrupt, at src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp:4133), the refund hook that used to live in OnSpellSuccessfulInterrupt (src/server/coa/AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp) could never fire for Chainwhip: its interrupt instead comes from AuraEffect::HandleAuraModSilence (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:3253) directly calling target->InterruptSpell on any of the target's current spells whose PreventionType is SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE (1), which never calls that hook. The fix detects the same condition one step earlier, in OnSpellCalculatedTarget (fired once per hit target from Spell::DoAllEffectOnLaunchTarget, before the HIT-phase aura application that performs the actual silence/interrupt), by checking whether the target currently has any CURRENT_MELEE_SPELL..CURRENT_AUTOREPEAT_SPELL entry whose PreventionType is SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE, and refunds 20% of RecoveryTime (4000ms) exactly once per cast via the same spell->GetScriptValue(800835) guard used before. Fixture: Scholomance Dark Summoner 11582 runs SmartAI casting Summon Risen Lackey 17618 (CastingTimeIndex 15, PreventionType SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_SILENCE, InterruptFlags 0x9, RecoveryTime 0) 2-5 sec after engaging and every 5-7 sec after, the same fixture used by bloodmage-aneurysm-interrupt-heal.json; cast_remaining_ms(spell=17618) names that exact cast so the scenario does not need to dodge the fixture's other, non-silence-preventable casts. Entry 36 (Harvest Golem, no smart_scripts rows) is a quiet hostile punching bag (creatures default to faction 14 in CoAGameplayTest.cpp) used for the non-interrupting baseline cast, since it never has a current spell for SilencedByHit to find.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Chainwhip's cooldown after a non-interrupting hit
SETUP: no refund happened against a target with no current spell
DETERMINISTIC GATE: the fixture caster is mid Summon Risen Lackey, not another of its casts
Let the detected cast run past its first update
The fixture caster is still mid Summon Risen Lackey
Regression guard: Chainwhip's silence interrupted Summon Risen Lackey
CONTRACT: Chainwhip's cooldown is refunded by 20% (4000 ms) of its 20000 ms cooldown
